# Graph operations · scene

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### scene.actorPerformance

Sample committed actor performance cues into a sprite pose, cast, props and lettering.

Origin: toolkit.
Samples the graph clock.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `sheet` | `record` | Required | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `actor` | `string` | `""` |  |
| Output | `value` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `pose` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `cast` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `props` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `lettering` | `array<record>` | — | {"items":"record"} |
| Output | `caption` | `string` | — |  |

Guides: [guide](../actor-performance.md#connect-rigging-and-lettering), [guide](../story-presentation-pack.md#plan-a-pack)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe scene.actorPerformance --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### scene.render



Origin: headless.
Samples the graph clock.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `world` | Required | {"layout":"Native world with 16 samples per splat row"} |
| Input | `camera` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `lights` | `array<record>` | `[]` | {"items":"record"} |
| Input | `channels` | `array<string>` | `["coverage","depth","normal","objectId","materialId","emission"]` | {"items":"string"} |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"width":{"type":"number","unit":"pixels","constraints":{"min":1,"max":2048,"integer":true},"default":128},"height":{"type":"number","unit":"pixels","constraints":{"min":1,"max":2048,"integer":true},"default":128},"time":{"type":"number","unit":"seconds"},"deepComposite":{"type":"boolean\|record","description":"Retain bounded per-pixel layers and selected planar reflection captures."},"objectMattes":{"type":"array<string\|number>","description":"Capture all camera and planar reflection coverage for up to eight selected objects."},"shutter":{"type":"boolean\|record","description":"Accumulate weighted subframes with object, material, pass and rolling shutter options."}} |
| Input | `renderGraphInputs` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `renderGraphCapture` | `array<string>` | `[]` | {"items":"string","maxItems":33,"uniqueItems":true} |
| Output | `value` | `displayRaster` | — | display byte levels · {"channels":[1,4],"samples":[0,255]} |
| Output | `frame` | `renderFrame` | — | {"layout":"Headless frame with width, height and RGB buffer"} |
| Output | `motionReference` | `any` | — |  |
| Output | `report` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |

- Width × height may not exceed 1,048,576 pixels.
- renderGraphInputs maps render-graph slot names to rasters. renderGraphCapture lists screen pass IDs to keep.

Guides: [guide](../art-passes.md#part-motion-and-previous-depth), [guide](../art-passes.md#strand-passes-and-pixel-inspection), [guide](../art-passes.md#object-mattes-and-light-groups), [guide](../art-passes.md#shared-opaque-surfaces), [guide](../graph-clips.md)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe scene.render --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.
